targetText: The usual advice to women to seek their salvation in marriage, this being their true profession, is thoughtlessly approved of by the vast majority of men.
summary: Examining demographic imbalances between men and women caused by war, emigration, industrial accidents, and economic crises, Bebel refutes those who tell women that marriage is their sole 'natural profession' when millions of women are structurally prevented from marrying.
